title: 包厢

series.next: The note says the library, after closing.

setting: An all-night KTV, Chengdu, 2:30 am. The note said the next ghost is real.

he.name: 何经理
he.en: the manager: tired, and sure it's haunted

xu.name: 老许
xu.en: a regular: the king of songs

steps.narr: On the club's table: a jar of 小潘's chilli sauce, and the note.

else.zh: 蒋叔跟整条街说，是我们抓的鬼！
else.en: 蒋叔 has told the whole street we caught his ghost!

steps.narr: An all-night KTV. Room 8 sings by itself at three. Always the same old song.

steps.en: This time... it's real, isn't it?

steps.narr: In the hall, a cleaner mops the floor, humming an old tune.

steps.zh: 八号包厢，没人订，每天自己唱。
steps.en: Room 8. No booking, and every night it sings by itself.

say.en: Ask the manager what time it starts singing.
say.tip: 几点 jǐ diǎn = what time: 几点开始？

ok.en: Three on the dot. One song, then it stops.

answers: 每天晚上几点开始唱的？
3.gloss: What time does it start, every night?

steps.zh: 我是这儿的歌王！八号是我的包厢！
steps.en: I'm the king of songs here! Room 8 is my room!
Three o'clock? I'm home in bed by then.

say.en: Ask who has a key to room 8.
say.gloss: Who has a key to room 8?
say.tip: 钥匙 yàoshi = key. 谁有……？ = who has ...?

ok.narr: The booking screen by the door lights up.
ok.zh: 八号包厢　预订人：保洁

answers: 除了经理，还有谁有钥匙？
3.gloss: Apart from you, who else has a key?
3.tip: 除了……还有…… = apart from ..., there's also ...

steps.narr: Three o'clock. From room 8: an old song, sung beautifully.

say.en: Set the trap: everyone, not a sound. Wait at the door.
say.gloss: Everyone, not a sound. Wait at the door!
say.tip: 出声 chūshēng = make a sound: 别出声 = keep quiet.

ok.narr: You wait by room 8's door. Through the glass, propped against the screen: a mop.

answers: 别出声，等歌唱完再进去。
都别出声，等歌唱完再进去。
3.gloss: Not a sound. We go in when the song's over.

not.note: He has a key, but who booked room 8? Read the screen again.
He's home by three. Who was humming that tune in the hall?

say.tip: 唱歌的 = the one singing: 的 makes a 'who'.

miss.narr: Everyone looks where you're pointing: at 包子. Again.

miss.zh: 包子这次真的不理你了。
miss.en: 包子 is not speaking to you. Properly, this time.

answers: 是邓阿姨！八号是保洁订的！
唱歌的就是邓阿姨，包厢是保洁订的！
3.gloss: It's 邓阿姨! The cleaner booked room 8!
3.tip: 保洁 bǎojié = cleaning staff. ……订的 = booked by ...

steps.en: When I was young, I sang for a living.

steps.zh: 下个月我女儿结婚，我想给她唱一首。
steps.en: My daughter gets married next month. I want to sing her a song.
At three, the rooms are all empty.

say.en: Let her finish the song, or turn the lights on.
say.tip: 唱完 = sing to the end: 完 after a verb = finished.

ok.narr: She sings it to the end. 何经理 claps first.

then.narr: The lights come up. 邓阿姨, in her uniform, holding the mic.

answers: 别打扰，让邓阿姨唱完吧。

alts.gloss: Lights on: let everyone hear it.

steps.zh: 以后三点，八号包厢归你。
steps.en: From now on, at three, room 8 is yours.

steps.narr: Back at the club: a second note under the door.
steps.zh: 这次是真的。图书馆，闭馆以后。

steps.en: At the wedding next month, the song is sung live. The club is invited. 🎤

else.en: Room 8 is 邓阿姨's every night at three, lights on. 老许 has a rival. 🎤
